subject: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing and final-invoice Net-90 request
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@aurorahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing for Aurora integration

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team is enthusiastic about moving forward. Procurement asked that we map payment to our fiscal milestones instead of a single upfront invoice. Our proposed schedule: 

- 40% on SOW signature (upon PO)
- 40% upon rollout to staging (target Q1)
- 20% 60 days after production go-live

Separately, due to Aurora's ERP cycle we are requesting Net-90 on the final 20% invoice (rather than Net-30). I attached the SOW and a short procurement note for reference. Could you confirm whether Redwood can accept milestone invoices and whether Net-90 on the final invoice requires a commercial concession or executive sign-off?

Appreciate a quick note on options/constraints and any documentation you need from our side (credit snapshot, PO timeline).

Best,
Carlos Mendez
Procurement Manager
Aurora Health
Attachments: Aurora_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), procurement_note_aurora.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing for Aurora integration

Folks — forwarding Aurora's request. Key asks: milestone invoicing (fine) + Net-90 on final invoice (customer asks due to ERP). They want to close this month.

Questions for deal desk/finance:
- Is milestone invoicing with three invoices acceptable from ops perspective?
- Net-90 on the final 20%: do we require a discount, additional fees, or executive approval?
- Any required docs (we can get their credit snapshot).

I included Vivek in case pricing or commercial concession is needed. Please advise next steps so I can reply to Carlos today.

Thanks,
Irene
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing for Aurora integration

Irene/Marissa — operationally the milestone schedule is straightforward. We can split invoices per milestone; billing ops will accept three invoices tied to SOW milestones.

Net-90 on the final invoice is outside standard commercial terms. For Net-90 on a final small tail (20%), we typically handle two approaches:
- Approve Net-90 with no discount if we have acceptable credit (requires credit check and PO on file).
- Or convert to Net-30 and offer 1-1.5% early-payment discount to compensate.

If Aurora can provide the credit snapshot (they attached one), we can run it through CreditOps and potentially approve Net-90 with Executive sign-off from Finance. Recommend we escalate with a short summary and ask for a decision matrix (approve as-is vs discount).

Ben
Head of Billing Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing for Aurora integration

Vivek — background: Aurora is mid-market healthcare org, ARR ~ $750k for roadmap + initial seats (see HubSpot 13745). They ask Net-90 only for the final 20% because their month-end cycles push larger vendors to that cadence. Billing ops says milestone invoicing OK. CreditOps needs the attached snapshot to greenlight Net-90.

Options I recommend to expedite the deal: 
1) Approve Net-90 on final invoice conditionally after CreditOps sign-off (no discount) — fastest path.
2) If CreditOps flags risk, offer Net-30 + 1.25% discount on final invoice (keeps cash flow).
3) If exec feels strongly we want to help win, approve Net-90 plus a small non-refundable staging payment holdback (e.g., 5% retained until payment cleared).

Vivek — can you approve conditional Net-90 pending the credit check? If not, state preferred fallback so I can propose to Aurora.

Marissa
Head of Finance (acting)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Conditional Net-90 on Aurora final invoice

Marissa/Irene/Ben — I support option 1: approve Net-90 on the final 20% invoice provided we get a clean CreditOps assessment and an executed PO before staging rollout. Conditions:

- CreditOps must complete a standard review and return green or amber with mitigations (amber requires 1.5% discount).
- Customer must provide official PO and the signed SOW prior to the staging invoice.
- Add a line in the SOW stating final invoice will be Net-90 subject to credit clearance.

Irene — you can relay conditional approval to Carlos and request the credit snapshot (they already attached one) and a PO timeline. If CreditOps returns amber, use Ben's fallback discount.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Structured milestone invoicing for Aurora integration

Carlos — quick update and next steps. Thank you for the SOW and procurement note. Redwood can accept the three-part milestone invoicing you proposed. On the Net-90 request for the final 20% invoice, we can approve that conditionally:

- Conditional approval: Net-90 on the final 20% provided CreditOps returns a clean assessment and we receive an executed PO before staging invoice. If CreditOps flags risk, we would move to Net-30 with a 1.5% discount on the final invoice.

Please send a clear PO timeline and permission to run the attached credit snapshot through our CreditOps team (we will only use it for approval purposes). Once we have the PO and confirmation, we will formalize the terms in the SOW and proceed to scheduling.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this signed.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: aurora_credit_snapshot.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Irene — thanks for the fast follow. We accept the conditional terms and grant permission to run the credit snapshot. PO is in drafting and should reach you by next Thursday (2026-10-14). I will attach the PO to the HubSpot record and email it directly when available.

Carlos
